evals.prompt:
Audit my Meta ads account. Here's the data:

```json
{"account": {"name": "Glow Skincare DTC", "id": "act_1122334455", "currency": "USD", "timezone": "America/New_York", "account_status": 1},
"pixel": {"pixel_id": "998877", "capi_enabled": false, "emq_score": 4.2, "last_event_at": "2026-06-09T18:00:00Z"},
"campaigns": [{"name": "Prospecting - ASC", "objective": "OUTCOME_SALES", "status": "ACTIVE", "daily_budget": 400, "spend_30d": 11800, "purchases": 310, "purchase_value": 35400, "roas": 3.0, "frequency": 2.1, "cpm": 14.2, "link_ctr": 1.6},
{"name": "Retargeting - 30d", "objective": "OUTCOME_SALES", "status": "ACTIVE", "daily_budget": 250, "spend_30d": 7400, "purchases": 96, "purchase_value": 11100, "roas": 1.5, "frequency": 8.4, "cpm": 22.8, "link_ctr": 0.7},
{"name": "Traffic - Blog", "objective": "OUTCOME_TRAFFIC", "status": "ACTIVE", "daily_budget": 100, "spend_30d": 2950, "purchases": 2, "purchase_value": 140, "roas": 0.05, "frequency": 1.4, "cpm": 6.1, "link_ctr": 2.4}],
"ad_sets": [{"name": "ASC - Broad", "campaign": "Prospecting - ASC", "learning_stage": "SUCCESS", "attribution_setting": "7d_click_1d_view"}, {"name": "RT 30d visitors", "campaign": "Retargeting - 30d", "learning_stage": "LEARNING_LIMITED", "attribution_setting": "7d_click_1d_view"}]}
```
evals.expected_output: A read-only audit that ranks findings by dollar impact: the Retargeting campaign's frequency 8.4 with 1.5x ROAS and learning-limited ad set is the biggest problem (audience exhaustion / budget too high for the pool); the Traffic campaign spends ~$3k/month with near-zero purchase value and deserves objective scrutiny; pixel health flags CAPI disabled and a mediocre EMQ score. ROAS figures are cited with the 7d-click/1d-view attribution window. The audit recommends fixes but never mutates the account, and points the user to /meta-ads to execute.
expectations: The audit is read-only — no pause, budget, or campaign mutations are attempted
Flags the Retargeting campaign's frequency 8.4 and weak ROAS as audience exhaustion with a concrete dollar-impact estimate
Flags the learning-limited retargeting ad set and ties it to the small audience or budget sizing
Flags CAPI disabled and the EMQ score as pixel-health issues affecting signal quality
Questions the Traffic objective campaign's ~$2,950/30d spend given near-zero purchase value
Cites the attribution window when quoting ROAS
Findings are prioritized by impact rather than listed in data order

evals.prompt: Set up my Meta ads — this is my first time using NotFair on this account.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs the onboarding path: shared preamble (MCP detection, OAuth, ad account selection), then gathers business context through conversation, then persists the filesystem contract — business-context.json under the account data dir's meta/ subdirectory and personas under meta/personas/. If a Google Ads business-context.json already exists in the data dir, it reuses the platform-agnostic fields instead of re-asking, and only collects Meta-specific extensions (funnel events, creative inventory, custom audiences, pixel health).
expectations: The skill resolves MCP connectivity and ad account selection via the shared preamble before anything else
The skill writes business-context.json to the meta/ subdirectory of the account data dir
The skill writes personas JSON including meta_creative_angles and visual_cues fields
If a Google Ads business-context.json exists, the skill reuses platform-agnostic fields instead of re-asking the user
The skill collects Meta-specific extensions such as funnel events and pixel health rather than only the generic schema
